sort_desc(
  label_join(
    label_join(
      (
        sum(our_service_status) by (service_name, service_directory)
      ) + 2,
      "repo_path",
      "/",
      "service_directory",
      "service_directory"
    ),
    "service_column",
    "#",
    "repo_path",
    "service_name"
  )
)
